hypothesis: Distinguish deformation artifacts from pose/contact incompatibility at identical bone states; allow physically connected white-key top sliding without artificial component seams.
deformation_ablation: Three frozen frame-24 contexts plus undeformed bind control; preserve volume off/on; base cage and actual renderer level-2 limit surface. No pose/bone/weight/scale edits within pairs.
joint_sweep_scope: One ring PIP coordinate and a 3×3 left thumb CMC grid; wrist, elbow and all other q are frozen. Selected changed poses reconstructed and independently audited in Blender.
static_union_ablation: Same measured fresh R frame24, anatomy, score/key commands, 120 mm static wrist workspace, human weight4 and 100×4 plus80 feasibility budget. Fixed component vs physical key-top union × source vs form-guided uncurl+8mm lift initialization. Original objective is unchanged by initialization. Finite outer-boundary margin, 10–100µm contact gap, instrument triangles, self mesh, proxy spacing and exact arms remain hard.

fixed_source.scope:
Search for a contact waypoint before planning its bounded approach path.

This keeps anatomy, fixed shoulder/arm lengths, actual skin/contact and proxy
finger spacing. Neighbor speed constraints are deliberately absent because no
trajectory is being exported or accepted. Wrist range is a planning workspace,
not an allowed per-frame jump. The waypoint must still pass mesh/mesh and
naturalness review and then be connected within the original motion bounds.

verification_repeat_scope: Only diagnostic checkpoint metadata changed after the four matched primary runs. The two union repeats reproduce their primary numerical gates exactly; actual Blender uses the identical score-held key commands. Right-hand instrument contacts clear, but both self surfaces and the unchanged left hand reject.

reviewed_method.scope: Methodological review using supplied primary notes; not empirical rig acceptance

source_precision_issue: Unchanged legacy left pinky abduction has 2.0152775e−6 rad excess from 5-decimal export. It is reported, not silently clamped. New production exports already retain solver precision.
retained_failed_attempts: Base cage was wrongly compared to a limit projection; corrected, regression tested, full audit rerun.
First joint sweep rejected legacy left q rounding excess after completing R rows; preserved, full diagnostic rerun with explicit bounds ledger.
Generic audit first duplicated candidate metadata; report merge corrected and failure log retained.

First independent union replay used source key depths instead of trial score-held commands. That mismatched audit is retained as union_verify_audit_20261011.json; it is not a trial result. Corrected matched reconstruction/audit is retained separately.
conclusion: Bind control has zero crossings at both levels. Quaternion deformation leaves all playing contexts rejected. Actual Blender verifies that isolated uncurling clears the changed hand but creates instrument penetration. Simultaneous key contact, hand posture and wrist planning must be solved together. The connected key-top option removes an artificial component seam but is not a force, naturalness or continuous-motion certificate.
